The only legal transitions are PENDING → PROCESSING and PROCESSING →

backwards, so a completed report can never silently change.

DashboardResponse.description:
Everything the home screen renders, in one payload.

The screen shows five sections at once. Serving them from one endpoint
keeps the first paint to a single round trip and, more importantly, makes
the sections mutually consistent: split across five calls, a vehicle could
appear in "saved" and vanish from "price drops" between requests.

info.description:
Truvix is an AI-assisted vehicle intelligence platform. The API powers vehicle
analysis, price tracking and the AI copilot used by the Truvix mobile client.

Errors are returned as RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` field.
info.title: Truvix API

get.description: Returns a page of the caller's analyses, newest first.

post.description: Creates a pending analysis for one of the caller's vehicles.

404.description: No such analysis in this account.

post.description: Uploads a photo or PDF to a pending analysis. The file's type is determined from its bytes; the declared content type is ignored.

get.description: Streams a previously uploaded photo or document.

post.description: Mails a fresh verification link to the signed-in account's address, replacing any link sent earlier.
Consumes a verification link and marks the address verified.

422.description: The link is unknown, spent or expired.

post.description: Exchanges an email address and password for a token pair.

429.description: Too many attempts from this client.

post.description: Invalidates the supplied refresh token.
Invalidates every session belonging to the authenticated account.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the signed-in account, everything in its garage and every photograph it uploaded. It cannot be undone, and it does not cancel an App Store subscription — only the customer can do that from their Apple ID settings.

401.description: Access token missing, or the password did not match.

get.description: Returns the account behind the supplied access token.

post.description: Consumes a reset link and replaces the password. Every existing session is revoked, because a reset may be somebody removing a stranger from their account.

422.description: The link is unknown, spent or expired, or the password was rejected.

post.description: Mails a reset link to the address, if an account exists for it. The response is identical either way — whether somebody has an account is not something this endpoint will confirm.

202.description: Accepted. This says nothing about whether the account exists.

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair. The presented token is invalidated; replaying it revokes every session for the account.

429.description: Too many attempts from this client.

post.description: Registers a new account and returns its first token pair.

409.description: Email address or phone number already registered.

429.description: Too many attempts from this client.
